context: Mom and daughter set the table together.
purpose: Casual home register hitting stragglers (そのまま/もらう/箸/入る/全員) naturally.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お箸を、全員分並べてくれる?
lines.en: Could you set out chopsticks for everyone?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring asking throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、箸はそのまま置いておくね。
lines.en: Sure, I'll just leave the chopsticks out.
lines.style: cheerful adult daughter voice, soft warm relaxed throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さんも、もうすぐ部屋に入るわ。
lines.en: Dad will come into the room soon too.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm affectionate throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 全員そろってから、食べる?
lines.en: Do we eat once everyone's gathered?
lines.style: curious adult daughter voice, soft warm relaxed throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ええ、温かいうちに食べてもらうわ。
lines.en: Yes, I'll have you all eat while it's warm.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: スープは、そのまま鍋でいい?
lines.en: Is the soup fine left in the pot?
lines.style: practical adult daughter voice, soft warm relaxed throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 手伝ってもらえて、本当に助かるわ。
lines.en: Having your help really saves me.
lines.style: grateful mother voice, soft warm tender throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 全員の箸、ちゃんと並べたよ。
lines.en: I set out everyone's chopsticks properly.
lines.style: satisfied adult daughter voice, soft warm cheerful closing throughout
